name: sound-effects
title: Sound effects
line: Our own whoosh, pop, click, hit, riser and ding on every cut, card or word, each on the first frame of its moment
card: Whooshes and pops on every cut
say: put a whoosh on every cut
add a pop when each card appears
add a ding when I say the number

askeditor.what: Add sound effects to my edit
askeditor.why: each sound stays a clip on the timeline: slide it, swap it or turn it down without rendering again
